implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/home/EventTimeline.tsx: Reads last 50 events from useEventStore event buffer. Each event: timestamp, type badge (Badge component), description text. Chronological order (newest first). Auto-updates as new events arrive via WebSocket.
implementationPlan.note: Created EventTimeline reading from useEventStore events buffer (last 50). Each event: timestamp, type badge (auto-variant from type string), description. Scrollable list with empty state.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/home/ActiveWorkflowCards.tsx: Uses useRecentRuns() filtered for in-progress status. Card per active run: workflow name, run ID, step progress (X/Y completed + ProgressBar), started time. Card links to /workflows/:id/runs/:runId. Empty state if no active runs.
implementationPlan.note: Created ActiveWorkflowCards using useRecentRuns filtered for active statuses. Each card: run ID, RunStatusBadge, started time, step progress (X/Y + ProgressBar). Links to /workflows/:id/runs/:runId. Loading skeleton and empty state.

implementationPlan.description: Integrate both components into HomePage.tsx at the bottom section in a two-column layout.
implementationPlan.note: Added EventTimeline and ActiveWorkflowCards imports. Placed in two-column grid below PoolUtilizationGrid.
